decks.domain: Traffic laws, crossings, lane markings and right of way

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Delaware prohibits texting and handheld phone use while driving; phone ____.
cards.back: Delaware prohibits texting and handheld phone use while driving; phone conversations require hands-free equipment.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A driver may dial or activate or deactivate wireless equipment, then ____.
cards.back: A driver may dial or activate or deactivate wireless equipment, then must set the device down.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The driving restriction also covers handheld electronic communication devices such as pagers, ____.
cards.back: The driving restriction also covers handheld electronic communication devices such as pagers, portable computers and two-way communication devices.
cards.memory_hook: portable computers and two-way communication devices

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A driver holding a GDL may not use a phone or electronic ____.
cards.back: A driver holding a GDL may not use a phone or electronic device while driving, even hands-free.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Authorized emergency-vehicle operators performing official duties and people reporting emergencies are ____.
cards.back: Authorized emergency-vehicle operators performing official duties and people reporting emergencies are excepted from the device-use restriction.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The device-use exemptions include operators of farm tractors, unregistered farm trucks or ____.
cards.back: The device-use exemptions include operators of farm tractors, unregistered farm trucks or farm equipment, and HAM radio operators.
cards.memory_hook: farm equipment, and HAM radio operators

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A business or government employee may use an attached or mounted two-way vehicle radio to communicate with dispatch, a base or ____.
cards.back: A business or government employee may use an attached or mounted two-way vehicle radio to communicate with dispatch, a base or other employees under the listed exemption.
cards.memory_hook: other employees under the listed exemption

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A driver must communicate an intended stop, turn or lane change by hand signal or turn signal ____.
cards.back: A driver must communicate an intended stop, turn or lane change by hand signal or turn signal three hundred feet before the action.
cards.memory_hook: three hundred feet before the action

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: When passing to the left, keep a safe distance and return right only ____.
cards.back: When passing to the left, keep a safe distance and return right only after safely clearing the other vehicle.
cards.memory_hook: after safely clearing the other vehicle

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Passing a cyclist requires at least three feet of ____.
cards.back: Passing a cyclist requires at least three feet of clearance throughout the pass.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: On a multilane road, a driver passing a cyclist must use ____.
cards.back: On a multilane road, a driver passing a cyclist must use the neighboring lane whenever possible.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A vehicle being passed must give way right and avoid accelerating ____.
cards.back: A vehicle being passed must give way right and avoid accelerating until the pass is complete.

decks.domain: Traffic laws, crossings, lane markings and right of way

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: For an approaching authorized emergency vehicle using a siren or the listed alternating red-light combinations, yield and move immediately to the right edge clear of intersections until ____.
cards.back: For an approaching authorized emergency vehicle using a siren or the listed alternating red-light combinations, yield and move immediately to the right edge clear of intersections until it passes, unless police direct otherwise.
cards.memory_hook: it passes, unless police direct otherwise

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The approaching-emergency-vehicle law also extends to DelDOT operators requested to support police ____.
cards.back: The approaching-emergency-vehicle law also extends to DelDOT operators requested to support police or fire personnel at an incident.
cards.memory_hook: or fire personnel at an incident

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: When approaching a stationary emergency, DelDOT, tow or other vehicle giving the described warnings, proceed cautiously and ____.
cards.back: When approaching a stationary emergency, DelDOT, tow or other vehicle giving the described warnings, proceed cautiously and change lanes to yield when possible.
cards.memory_hook: change lanes to yield when possible

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: If moving over would be unsafe or impossible, proceed carefully and ____.
cards.back: If moving over would be unsafe or impossible, proceed carefully and slow to a safe speed.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The listed alternating warning colors for stationary emergency vehicles are red alone, blue alone, blue paired with white, red paired with white ____.
cards.back: The listed alternating warning colors for stationary emergency vehicles are red alone, blue alone, blue paired with white, red paired with white or blue, and the red-white-blue combination.
cards.memory_hook: or blue, and the red-white-blue combination

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The stationary DelDOT warning described in the move-over rule uses ____.
cards.back: The stationary DelDOT warning described in the move-over rule uses alternating amber or red-and-amber lights.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The stationary tow-truck warning described in the move-over rule uses alternating ____.
cards.back: The stationary tow-truck warning described in the move-over rule uses alternating amber, white or amber-and-white lights.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The move-over rule also includes a stationary vehicle displaying hazard lights, flares, cones, caution ____.
cards.back: The move-over rule also includes a stationary vehicle displaying hazard lights, flares, cones, caution signs or other nonvehicle warning signs.
cards.memory_hook: signs or other nonvehicle warning signs

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: On a multilane roadway, move one lane away from a stopped ____.
cards.back: On a multilane roadway, move one lane away from a stopped vehicle until safely beyond it.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: On a two-lane roadway, slow below the posted limit until ____.
cards.back: On a two-lane roadway, slow below the posted limit until completely beyond the stopped vehicle.

decks.domain: Traffic laws, crossings, lane markings and right of way

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Delaware traffic laws apply to all highway users, including drivers, cyclists, people guiding ____.
cards.back: Delaware traffic laws apply to all highway users, including drivers, cyclists, people guiding vehicles or riding animals, and pedestrians.
cards.memory_hook: vehicles or riding animals, and pedestrians

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Follow a police officer’s instructions even when they conflict with signs, signals, ____.
cards.back: Follow a police officer’s instructions even when they conflict with signs, signals, markings or usual traffic laws.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Do not bypass a traffic sign or signal by leaving the ____.
cards.back: Do not bypass a traffic sign or signal by leaving the roadway and crossing private property.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Every grade crossing has an emergency dispatch number for reporting crossing, track ____.
cards.back: Every grade crossing has an emergency dispatch number for reporting crossing, track or train problems to the railroad.
cards.memory_hook: or train problems to the railroad

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The railroad emergency notification number is normally on a blue sign at ____.
cards.back: The railroad emergency notification number is normally on a blue sign at the crossbuck or near the crossing.
cards.memory_hook: the crossbuck or near the crossing

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The ENS sign’s DOT number identifies the crossing location for ____.
cards.back: The ENS sign’s DOT number identifies the crossing location for responders and railroad personnel.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Giving the dispatcher the crossing’s DOT number helps locate a blockage so approaching ____.
cards.back: Giving the dispatcher the crossing’s DOT number helps locate a blockage so approaching trains can be slowed or stopped.
cards.memory_hook: trains can be slowed or stopped

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Never attempt to race a train through ____.
cards.back: Never attempt to race a train through a railroad crossing.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Do not start across tracks unless the far side has enough room for the entire ____.
cards.back: Do not start across tracks unless the far side has enough room for the entire vehicle without stopping on the tracks.
cards.memory_hook: vehicle without stopping on the tracks

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The handbook recommends avoiding gear changes while traversing tracks because ____.
cards.back: The handbook recommends avoiding gear changes while traversing tracks because of the risk of stalling.

decks.domain: Traffic laws, crossings, lane markings and right of way

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The advance railroad warning is a round yellow sign bearing a ____.
cards.back: The advance railroad warning is a round yellow sign bearing a black X and RR letters.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Rail-crossing advance pavement markings commonly contain an X, RR letters ____.
cards.back: Rail-crossing advance pavement markings commonly contain an X, RR letters and a stopping bar.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A white X-shaped railroad crossbuck has the meaning of a yield sign ____.
cards.back: A white X-shaped railroad crossbuck has the meaning of a yield sign and requires yielding to trains.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Flashing side-by-side railroad-crossing lights require ____.
cards.back: Flashing side-by-side railroad-crossing lights require a stop.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Never drive around a lowered ____.
cards.back: Never drive around a lowered railroad gate.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Where a crossing bell sounds, do not cross ____.
cards.back: Where a crossing bell sounds, do not cross until it stops.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A track-count sign warns of multiple tracks and possible additional trains; even without one, ____.
cards.back: A track-count sign warns of multiple tracks and possible additional trains; even without one, check for more than one track.
cards.memory_hook: check for more than one track

decks.domain: Traffic laws, crossings, lane markings and right of way

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A solid white road-edge line identifies the outer edge ____.
cards.back: A solid white road-edge line identifies the outer edge of the travel lane.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: White lane markings separate traffic lanes moving in ____.
cards.back: White lane markings separate traffic lanes moving in the same direction.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A broken white lane line may be crossed for ____.
cards.back: A broken white lane line may be crossed for a safe lane change.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A single solid white lane line ____.
cards.back: A single solid white lane line discourages changing lanes.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A double solid white lane line ____.
cards.back: A double solid white lane line prohibits changing lanes.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: When a sign or signal requires stopping, stop before reaching ____.
cards.back: When a sign or signal requires stopping, stop before reaching the stopping line or crosswalk.

decks.domain: Traffic laws, crossings, lane markings and right of way

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A crosswalk can exist without painted markings, so remain alert ____.
cards.back: A crosswalk can exist without painted markings, so remain alert for pedestrians at intersections.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Yellow lines separate opposing directions ____.
cards.back: Yellow lines separate opposing directions of traffic.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A broken yellow center line may be crossed ____.
cards.back: A broken yellow center line may be crossed to pass when safe.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Where opposing lanes have one solid and one broken yellow line, passing ____.
cards.back: Where opposing lanes have one solid and one broken yellow line, passing is prohibited from the solid-line side.
cards.memory_hook: is prohibited from the solid-line side

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Where a solid and broken yellow line are paired, a driver on ____.
cards.back: Where a solid and broken yellow line are paired, a driver on the broken-line side may pass safely.
cards.memory_hook: the broken-line side may pass safely

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Two solid yellow center lines prohibit passing ____.
cards.back: Two solid yellow center lines prohibit passing from either direction.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A solid yellow line may be crossed for a safe ____.
cards.back: A solid yellow line may be crossed for a safe turn into a driveway.

decks.domain: Traffic laws, crossings, lane markings and right of way

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Reversible lanes change travel direction at different times and are normally marked with paired broken yellow lines; check ____.
cards.back: Reversible lanes change travel direction at different times and are normally marked with paired broken yellow lines; check which lane is available before entering.
cards.memory_hook: which lane is available before entering

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A green arrow above a reversible lane allows ____.
cards.back: A green arrow above a reversible lane allows use of that lane.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A red X above a reversible lane ____.
cards.back: A red X above a reversible lane prohibits its use.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A steady yellow X means lane use is changing; leave the lane ____.
cards.back: A steady yellow X means lane use is changing; leave the lane as soon as safely possible.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A lane marked Transit or Bus is reserved for buses, while a ____.
cards.back: A lane marked Transit or Bus is reserved for buses, while a Bicycle designation reserves it for bicycles.
cards.memory_hook: Bicycle designation reserves it for bicycles

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: HOV signs specify the required number of occupants and applicable times; HOV three requires at ____.
cards.back: HOV signs specify the required number of occupants and applicable times; HOV three requires at least three people in the vehicle.
cards.memory_hook: least three people in the vehicle

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A roundabout moves traffic counterclockwise around ____.
cards.back: A roundabout moves traffic counterclockwise around a central island.

decks.domain: Traffic laws, crossings, lane markings and right of way

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: For a roundabout, use the right approach lane for a right turn and the left for a left turn or U-turn; either ____.
cards.back: For a roundabout, use the right approach lane for a right turn and the left for a left turn or U-turn; either approach lane may serve straight travel.
cards.memory_hook: approach lane may serve straight travel

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Approach a roundabout to the splitter island’s right and slow to ten ____.
cards.back: Approach a roundabout to the splitter island’s right and slow to ten to fifteen miles per hour

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: At a roundabout entrance, watch for bicyclists and permit them to ____.
cards.back: At a roundabout entrance, watch for bicyclists and permit them to merge into the entry lane.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Yield to pedestrians using the ____.
cards.back: Yield to pedestrians using the roundabout crosswalk.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Entering drivers must yield to vehicles already circulating ____.
cards.back: Entering drivers must yield to vehicles already circulating in the roundabout.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Within a roundabout, stop only to avoid a collision; circulating traffic ____.
cards.back: Within a roundabout, stop only to avoid a collision; circulating traffic has priority over entering traffic.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Travel counterclockwise to the central island’s right, keep speed low and do ____.
cards.back: Travel counterclockwise to the central island’s right, keep speed low and do not pass within the roundabout.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: When exiting a roundabout, watch for and yield to ____.
cards.back: When exiting a roundabout, watch for and yield to both pedestrians and bicyclists.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A diverging diamond interchange temporarily routes traffic on the road’s left side so ____.
cards.back: A diverging diamond interchange temporarily routes traffic on the road’s left side so left turns avoid crossing opposing traffic.
cards.memory_hook: left turns avoid crossing opposing traffic

decks.module: Shared turning lanes and right turns (A)
decks.domain: Traffic laws, crossings, lane markings and right of way

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A shared center lane serves left turns and permitted U-turns by ____.
cards.back: A shared center lane serves left turns and permitted U-turns by traffic traveling in either direction.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Shared-center-lane pavement arrows alternate directions, and its boundaries pair a solid yellow ____.
cards.back: Shared-center-lane pavement arrows alternate directions, and its boundaries pair a solid yellow line with a broken yellow line.
cards.memory_hook: line with a broken yellow line

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A shared center lane can become reversible during rush hours; confirm ____.
cards.back: A shared center lane can become reversible during rush hours; confirm entry is permitted and safe.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Do not reverse in a travel lane except to parallel park or ____.
cards.back: Do not reverse in a travel lane except to parallel park or when necessary to leave a driveway.
cards.memory_hook: when necessary to leave a driveway

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: After missing a turn or exit, continue to a safe ____.
cards.back: After missing a turn or exit, continue to a safe turnaround instead of backing up.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Do not stop in a travel lane for confusion, a breakdown or a passenger; continue ____.
cards.back: Do not stop in a travel lane for confusion, a breakdown or a passenger; continue until you can safely pull off.
cards.memory_hook: until you can safely pull off

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: On roads with at least two same-direction lanes, keep ____.
cards.back: On roads with at least two same-direction lanes, keep right except when passing.

decks.module: Shared turning lanes and right turns (B)
decks.domain: Traffic laws, crossings, lane markings and right of way

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: On roads with at least three same-direction lanes and heavy entering or exiting ____.
cards.back: On roads with at least three same-direction lanes and heavy entering or exiting traffic, use the center travel lane.
cards.memory_hook: traffic, use the center travel lane

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The far-left lane on a multilane road is intended ____.
cards.back: The far-left lane on a multilane road is intended for passing slower traffic.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Delaware permits passing a left-turning vehicle on the right, but ____.
cards.back: Delaware permits passing a left-turning vehicle on the right, but this maneuver demands great caution.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Delaware permits using the shoulder to pass a left-turning vehicle on the right, with extreme care ____.
cards.back: Delaware permits using the shoulder to pass a left-turning vehicle on the right, with extreme care because others may not expect it.
cards.memory_hook: because others may not expect it

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Without turn-control signs or markings, turn from the lane nearest the intended direction into the closest corresponding lane, ____.
cards.back: Without turn-control signs or markings, turn from the lane nearest the intended direction into the closest corresponding lane, crossing as few lanes as possible.
cards.memory_hook: crossing as few lanes as possible

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Make a turn directly without straying across lane lines or obstructing traffic; ____.
cards.back: Make a turn directly without straying across lane lines or obstructing traffic; change lanes afterward if needed.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Avoid swinging left before a right turn or wide into a ____.
cards.back: Avoid swinging left before a right turn or wide into a distant lane while completing it.

decks.module: Left turns, lanes and entry priority (A)
decks.domain: Traffic laws, crossings, lane markings and right of way

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Do not cut a left-turn corner sharply into traffic approaching from the ____.
cards.back: Do not cut a left-turn corner sharply into traffic approaching from the left; leave room for opposing left-turners.
cards.memory_hook: left; leave room for opposing left-turners

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Where multiple lanes are designated for a turn, remain in your ____.
cards.back: Where multiple lanes are designated for a turn, remain in your own lane throughout the turn.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A median opening marked for emergency vehicles only may not ____.
cards.back: A median opening marked for emergency vehicles only may not be used by ordinary drivers.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: When a median crossing is legal and no sign says otherwise, stay ____.
cards.back: When a median crossing is legal and no sign says otherwise, stay to the right of its opening.
cards.memory_hook: to the right of its opening

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Whatever the right-of-way situation, do everything possible to avoid striking ____.
cards.back: Whatever the right-of-way situation, do everything possible to avoid striking another vehicle or a pedestrian.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Drivers must yield when needed to avoid hitting ____.
cards.back: Drivers must yield when needed to avoid hitting pedestrians crossing the road.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: When entering or leaving a driveway, alley or parking lot across ____.
cards.back: When entering or leaving a driveway, alley or parking lot across a sidewalk, yield to pedestrians.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Driving along a sidewalk is illegal; crossing it ____.
cards.back: Driving along a sidewalk is illegal; crossing it is the permitted exception.

decks.module: Left turns, lanes and entry priority (B)
decks.domain: Traffic laws, crossings, lane markings and right of way

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A pedestrian using a guide dog or white cane has absolute priority; do not sound the ____.
cards.back: A pedestrian using a guide dog or white cane has absolute priority; do not sound the horn and risk confusion or fright.
cards.memory_hook: horn and risk confusion or fright

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A left-turning driver must yield to opposing ____.
cards.back: A left-turning driver must yield to opposing vehicles continuing straight.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Drivers entering a traffic circle or rotary must give way ____.
cards.back: Drivers entering a traffic circle or rotary must give way to those already inside.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: At an intersection without a stop or yield sign or signal, yield to traffic from the right; the handbook also ____.
cards.back: At an intersection without a stop or yield sign or signal, yield to traffic from the right; the handbook also recommends considering all vehicles before entry.
cards.memory_hook: recommends considering all vehicles before entry

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: At a four-way stop, the first driver to arrive proceeds ____.
cards.back: At a four-way stop, the first driver to arrive proceeds first after stopping completely.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: If vehicles reach a four-way stop together, the one on ____.
cards.back: If vehicles reach a four-way stop together, the one on the right proceeds first.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Entering a road from a driveway, alley or roadside requires yielding to ____.
cards.back: Entering a road from a driveway, alley or roadside requires yielding to traffic on the main road.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Vehicles entering from turn-only lanes must yield and ____.
cards.back: Vehicles entering from turn-only lanes must yield and stop when necessary.

decks.module: Intersection exit space and school buses
decks.domain: Traffic laws, crossings, lane markings and right of way

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Do not enter an intersection unless you can clear it ____.
cards.back: Do not enter an intersection unless you can clear it without stopping and blocking it.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A driver overtaking a same-direction vehicle must yield to that vehicle even ____.
cards.back: A driver overtaking a same-direction vehicle must yield to that vehicle even if it slows or stops.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Yield to an emergency vehicle using a siren, air horn or flashing red or blue light by moving as far right ____.
cards.back: Yield to an emergency vehicle using a siren, air horn or flashing red or blue light by moving as far right as possible, following any loudspeaker instructions.
cards.memory_hook: as possible, following any loudspeaker instructions

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: If already in an intersection when an emergency vehicle approaches, clear ____.
cards.back: If already in an intersection when an emergency vehicle approaches, clear the intersection before pulling over.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Stop before a school bus loading or unloading children from either direction, except opposing traffic on a highway with at least four ____.
cards.back: Stop before a school bus loading or unloading children from either direction, except opposing traffic on a highway with at least four lanes, which must still move slowly.
cards.memory_hook: lanes, which must still move slowly

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A bus’s alternating overhead yellow lights activate about ten seconds before its flashing red lights; ____.
cards.back: A bus’s alternating overhead yellow lights activate about ten seconds before its flashing red lights; approach carefully and expect a stop.
cards.memory_hook: approach carefully and expect a stop

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: After a bus stops for pupils, wait until its red lights cease and its ____.
cards.back: After a bus stops for pupils, wait until its red lights cease and its stop arm retracts before proceeding cautiously.
cards.memory_hook: stop arm retracts before proceeding cautiously

decks.domain: Traffic laws, crossings, lane markings and right of way

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: If police, a bus operator or a crossing guard witnesses a school-bus-stop violation and cannot identify the driver, the registered owner ____.
cards.back: If police, a bus operator or a crossing guard witnesses a school-bus-stop violation and cannot identify the driver, the registered owner is presumed to have committed it.
cards.memory_hook: is presumed to have committed it

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: For a first conviction of passing a bus stopped with overhead and stop-arm red lights flashing, the fine is one hundred fifteen ____.
cards.back: For a first conviction of passing a bus stopped with overhead and stop-arm red lights flashing, the fine is one hundred fifteen dollars to two hundred thirty dollars.
cards.memory_hook: dollars to two hundred thirty dollars

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The same first bus-passing offense may carry thirty to sixty days of ____.
cards.back: The same first bus-passing offense may carry thirty to sixty days of imprisonment, alone or with the fine.
cards.memory_hook: imprisonment, alone or with the fine

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A similar bus-passing offense within three years carries a fine of one hundred fifteen ____.
cards.back: A similar bus-passing offense within three years carries a fine of one hundred fifteen dollars to five hundred seventy-five dollars.
cards.memory_hook: dollars to five hundred seventy-five dollars

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A later similar bus-passing offense within three years also carries imprisonment from ____.
cards.back: A later similar bus-passing offense within three years also carries imprisonment from sixty days to six months.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A first conviction for passing a stopped bus with the described flashing red lights results in ____.
cards.back: A first conviction for passing a stopped bus with the described flashing red lights results in a one-month license or driving-privilege suspension.
cards.memory_hook: a one-month license or driving-privilege suspension

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: For a second school-bus violation within three years of an earlier violation, the source ____.
cards.back: For a second school-bus violation within three years of an earlier violation, the source table gives six months of suspension.
cards.memory_hook: table gives six months of suspension

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The school-bus conviction table gives a one-year suspension for a third or later violation within ____.
cards.back: The school-bus conviction table gives a one-year suspension for a third or later violation within three years of an earlier violation.
cards.memory_hook: three years of an earlier violation

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: For a second school-bus offense, a conditional license may be issued only after at ____.
cards.back: For a second school-bus offense, a conditional license may be issued only after at least three months without driving authority.
cards.memory_hook: least three months without driving authority

decks.domain: Traffic laws, crossings, lane markings and right of way

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: For a third or later school-bus offense, a conditional license may be issued only after at ____.
cards.back: For a third or later school-bus offense, a conditional license may be issued only after at least six months without driving authority.
cards.memory_hook: least six months without driving authority

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: No driving authority is available during the first ____.
cards.back: No driving authority is available during the first school-bus offense’s one-month suspension.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The handbook’s Red Clay school-bus camera pilot description gives a one hundred dollars civil or ____.
cards.back: The handbook’s Red Clay school-bus camera pilot description gives a one hundred dollars civil or administrative assessment for a first violation.
cards.memory_hook: administrative assessment for a first violation

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: In that camera-pilot description, each subsequent violation within ten years has ____.
cards.back: In that camera-pilot description, each subsequent violation within ten years has a five hundred dollars assessment.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The described school district camera pilot may add up to ten dollars when an ____.
cards.back: The described school district camera pilot may add up to ten dollars when an assessment remains unpaid for twenty days.
cards.memory_hook: assessment remains unpaid for twenty days

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The camera-pilot late-payment assessment may rise to at most twenty ____.
cards.back: The camera-pilot late-payment assessment may rise to at most twenty dollars after forty-five days.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The camera-pilot late-payment assessment may rise to at most thirty ____.
cards.back: The camera-pilot late-payment assessment may rise to at most thirty dollars after ninety days.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The camera-pilot description permits up to thirty-five dollars in court or similar administrative costs after an unsuccessful hearing or failure ____.
cards.back: The camera-pilot description permits up to thirty-five dollars in court or similar administrative costs after an unsuccessful hearing or failure to pay or contest on time.
cards.memory_hook: to pay or contest on time

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A civilly assessed violation under the described camera pilot is not criminal and does not enter ____.
cards.back: A civilly assessed violation under the described camera pilot is not criminal and does not enter the driving record or insurance determination.
cards.memory_hook: the driving record or insurance determination
